provenance.disclosure: Market factor, not a ticker. Daily market excess returns (Rm-Rf), from one revised research release. Source availability is the actual capture time, never backdated. Chronological splits order observations within this fixed vintage; they do not reconstruct historically available vintages. HMM posteriors use the entire admitted history retrospectively. Compounded excess returns are a dimensionless research index, not an investable total-return index or an absolute price. No alpha claim.
provenance.return_definition: Rm-Rf; source percentage holding-period returns divided by 100
